evidence.text: A person 卩 putting on 又 a coat 月
Pictograph of a person being served a plate.
用也。一曰車右騑，所以舟旋。从舟𠬝聲。

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *bɯɡ): semantic 凡 (“tray”) + phonetic 𠬝 (*[b]ək, “to subdue”) – to serve. 𠬝 is the original pictogram for this character; 凡 was added later.
凡 here has been corrupted into 舟 and subsequently 月.
用也。一曰車右騑，所以舟旋。从舟𠬝聲。
